description: Distribute items evenly (Object > Distribute, Align panel): by left, horizontal centre or right edges, top, vertical centre or bottom edges, or equal horizontal or vertical space between them. The outermost items stay put. With spacing (hspace, vspace), items are set exactly that many points apart, starting from the key object (or the first item), which does not move

keyObjectId.description: With spacing: the id of the item that stays still (Key Object). Default the leftmost or topmost item

spacing.description: hspace or vspace: the exact gap in points (Distribute Spacing)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

usePreviewBounds.description: Measure including strokes and effects (Use Preview Bounds). Default true

name: distribute_items
title: Distribute Items
